desc: 加厚原木块配三合一配对板，数字动物图形配对又能拱形叠高
leaf: 儿童加厚原木方块配三合一配对板积木（厚木块面带彩色字母数字与单色刻线卡通图案，含数字/动物/图形三条配对轨道板）
name: 三合一配对板加厚原木积木款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清这是加厚原木方块，块面同时带彩色字母数字与单色刻线卡通图案，并用阶梯堆加拱形前排列出体量感，抢点击且满足白底主图合规。
详情页首屏一秒抛出最大购买理由：大字标题加三条轨道图标位，把数字、动物、图形三条配对玩法一次说完，承接主图点击。
shots.textZone: headline field in the upper half of the panel, one tracked Latin support line beneath it, a column of three icon-and-label rows at the left of the panel

shots.intent: 先放大家长每天真遇到的烦扰：木块倒了一地、配对板空着没人归位，再在同一屏用块子坐进槽位的画面给出解决姿态。
shots.textZone: headline strip across the top, one short label centered under each panel

shots.intent: 把这款最核心的结构一次摊清：一块配对板上三条配对轨道，槽形与块面图案一一对应，让人秒懂玩法机制而不是靠文字解释。
shots.textZone: one hexagon-outline number badge and short label at the head of each of the three slot tracks

shots.intent: 把产品放进真实玩的世界：地垫上一块配对板、一列叠起的厚块和一只小手，让家长代入自家孩子的抓握与配对画面，同时用尺度感说明块子好不好拿。
shots.textZone: one short heading placeholder at the upper left of the frame

shots.intent: 用一张微距让工艺自己说话：刻线凹进木面、边缘不飞边、彩色印面与裸木交界干净，以质感证明替代任何无法核实的安全话术。
shots.textZone: one caption card at the lower left holding a single short label

shots.intent: 回应厚到什么程度、一只手抓不抓得住：单块侧面轮廓配掌心参照与标尺位，把尺寸与适龄交给卖家填真值。
shots.textZone: thin dimension rules around the measured cube at the left, three short label rows stacked at the right under the palm

shots.intent: 把三条配对轨道按组排开，让人一次看清一套里有几种配对内容，替买家在同一屏完成选款与凑单决定。
shots.textZone: one short group label at the head of each of the three rows, one highlighted pill label beside the middle row

shots.intent: 收掉风险：把工艺要点排成编号 zigzag 三格，每格一张实拍特写加一句短说明，参数与安全结论一律留空由卖家填真值。
shots.textZone: one hexagon-outline number badge plus one short label inside each of the three panels, headline above the stack

shots.intent: 详情页最后一屏收口：仰视把阶梯堆拍出气势，配一个明确的按钮动作把看完的犹豫转成加购。
shots.textZone: clean headline field above the stack, rounded CTA button below the headline, one short tracked Latin side-label at the right rule

style.backgroundSystem: flat #F5F4F2 studio fields carrying one large #F8D3B4 panel whose single deep rounded corner notch is the signature shape, plus at most one #EDECEA grey info block per screen; one #3A2418 hairline vertical rule with a vertical dot column and small tracked Latin side-labels at the right edge; seamless #FFFFFF sweep only on the packshot; no photographic clutter behind infographic screens
style.direction: warm toddler solid-wood block ecommerce, editorial flat-panel layout with strict infographic discipline
style.iconSystem: single-weight #3A2418 line pictograms seated on a soft #F8D3B4 disc, hexagon-outline number badges drawn with a #3A2418 hairline and holding one digit, three-dot #E07B2A row markers and a short three-line rule mark at the panel foot; no filled emblems, no certificate artwork, no seals
style.lightingSystem: daylight-balanced 5500K soft key from the upper left, broad bounce fill on the shadow side, true contact shadows under every cube and under the matching plate, controlled highlights on printed and engraved faces, short raking light only inside macro crops, gentle falloff to #FFFFFF at the frame edges, no harsh speculars, no dramatic falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm toddler solid-wood block ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of #F5F4F2 studio field, #F8D3B4 notched peach panel and #EDECEA grey info block, with #3A2418 espresso label ink, #E07B2A dot accent and one swappable highlight {accent_color}; neutral daylight tone; one geometric sans-serif family, heavy display headlines set in #3A2418 at 32-46pt with one {accent_color} disc overlapping the final glyph, small uppercase tracked Latin side-labels at 11-13pt, sublines at 16-20pt and labels at 10-14pt in #3A2418; background system of flat #F5F4F2 fields carrying one large #F8D3B4 panel whose single deep rounded corner notch is the signature shape, at most one #EDECEA info block per screen, and one #3A2418 hairline vertical rule with a vertical dot column and tracked Latin side-labels at the right edge; lighting system of a 5500K soft key from the upper left, broad bounce fill, true contact shadows under every cube and under the matching plate, controlled highlights on printed and engraved faces and short raking light only inside macro crops; surface system of matte #FFFFFF sweep, #F5F4F2 field, #F8D3B4 panel and #EDECEA block with the plate bare substrate edge reading as warm wood tone only where the cut is visible; icon system of single-weight #3A2418 line pictograms seated on a soft #F8D3B4 disc, hexagon-outline number badges with a #3A2418 hairline holding one digit, three-dot #E07B2A row markers and a short three-line rule mark at the panel foot; cubes and the matching plate always rendered true to the reference with real engraving and ink-in-grain texture, stable cube scale, thickness and corner radius, never floating without a contact shadow, no identifiable child face in any screen; noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent colors beyond {accent_color}
no mixed fonts, no handwritten, serif or cartoon lettering
no random backgrounds and no stock-photo interiors on infographic screens
no inconsistent lighting direction and no missing contact shadows
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge artwork
no redrawn, restyled or invented printed glyphs or engraved motifs on any cube face
no QR codes, no store badges, no membership copy, no watermark
style.presentationRules: cube printed glyphs, engraved line motifs, colors, thickness, proportions and corner radii and the plate slot shapes come only from the reference image and never change between screens; printed and engraved artwork is never redrawn, restyled or invented; the fanned arc row and the stepped stack keep the same cube scale, thickness and radius across the set; at least one overhead and one low camera in every set; product never floats without a contact shadow; no identifiable child face in any screen
style.surfaceSystem: matte #FFFFFF sweep for the packshot, #F5F4F2 field for infographic screens, #F8D3B4 panel for benefit and close screens, #EDECEA block for the numbered craft column; the plate bare substrate edge reads as a warm wood tone only where the cut is visible; surfaces stay clean, unwrinkled, debris-free
style.typography: one geometric sans-serif family across Chinese and Latin; heavy display weight for headlines only (32-46pt, set in #3A2418 with one {accent_color} disc overlapping the final glyph), small uppercase tracked Latin side-labels at 11-13pt, sublines at 16-20pt and labels at 10-14pt in #3A2418; all in-image copy rendered only as short 「{selling_point_N}」 and 「{callout_N}」 placeholders, per-screen budget under 40 characters
